name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Technical Account Manager | Client-Facing Technical Support, AI Systems & Communication Translation
summary: Account and support professional with 15+ years translating technical systems for both technical and non-technical audiences, most recently building and troubleshooting AI agent workflows and API-integrated CRM systems at Solenzo. Comfortable owning a small, high-touch book of accounts and being the technical point of contact customers trust. Deep API/SSO-level debugging (HAR files, network traces, SAML) isn't yet part of the toolkit, worth saying plainly, but the pattern of quickly building technical fluency on a new platform is consistent across the last 15 years.

Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
Build reusable agent infrastructure and internal tooling integrating with client CRMs and CMS platforms for 24/7 automated growth engines.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor agent outputs and continuously optimize performance.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable across GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project and process records auditable across concurrent engagements.
